doc.title: Story 15.2: Retention Curve Analysis

artifact.reason: Foundation service pattern. Shows how to aggregate video metrics and calculate performance indicators.
Daily metrics service. DailyMetricData includes impressions and clicks - needed for CTR calculation.
Content metadata service. Used to link thumbnails to content and retrieve video information.
Reference pattern for pattern detection and suggestion generation. Shows how to analyze content elements and generate actionable suggestions.
Reference for analysis display with expandable sections and suggestions list.
